theorem answer : YM.Bid.B13 := by
  intro G C S V A P X H _ hs hA _ ho p hr i Z
  classical
  have he (d : ℝ≥0) (w : C.book.Word) : ∃ U : Z.GNS.H.Op, ∀ h : Slab timeAxis d w,
      ‖U‖ ≤ ‖A.place d w‖ ∧ ∀ v, U (Z.GNS.plant v) = Z.GNS.plant (entering h v) := by
    by_cases h : Slab timeAxis d w
    · obtain ⟨U,hU⟩ := actual A H hs ho (hr.reads i) Z (hr.loci i) h
      exact ⟨U,fun _ => hU⟩
    · exact ⟨0,fun hp => (h hp).elim⟩
  choose U hU using he
  let B : Spread Z := ⟨U,fun h => (hU _ _ h).2⟩
  refine ⟨B,fun D R => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨K,J,hK,hJ⟩ := hA.cap D R
  exact ⟨K,J,hK,fun w d hc hw r hr hb hB =>
    le_trans (show ‖B.place d w‖ ≤ ‖A.place d w‖ from (hU d w hw).1) (hJ w d hc hw r hr hb hB)⟩

proof_context.conclusion: Each phase gets slab operators `U` with ||U|| <= ||A.place d w|| acting on plants by `entering`, and the cap bounds with the original constants.

theorem answer : YM.Bid.B02 := by
  intro G L S T P V A _ hT hr _ ht hD hb
  constructor
  · exact hb
  · intro d n v
    rw [show {x | Slab timeAxis d (realize v x)} = region timeAxis d n from
      Set.ext fun x => in_region d v x]
    exact smooth_place P A d ht hT.smooth hr hD hb v
  intro d n v x p hx j
  let b := (p,j)
  change Analysis.D _ _ _ = A.place d (realize (nextLabels P v b) x)
  unfold Analysis.D
  rw [(deriv_place P A d ht hT.smooth hr hD hb v ((in_region d v x).1 hx)).fderiv]
  exact columnD_column P A d v x b

proof_context.conclusion: For the resulting spread the slab laws, smoothness and the derivative identity hold.
